description: This Java source file defines the WiFiDirectActivity class, an Android activity that manages WiFi Direct (P2P) device discovery and connection. It utilizes the WiFiP2pManager API to handle WiFi Direct operations, manages UI fragments for device listing and details, and processes relevant system broadcasts to coordinate WiFi P2P states.

classes.name: WiFiDirectActivity
classes.description: Main activity class that manages WiFi Direct device discovery, connection, and UI interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up intent filters, checks WiFi P2P support, and requests necessary permissions.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers the broadcast receiver for WiFi P2P events.

methods.name: resetData
methods.description: Clears peer list and device details UI fragments.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for WiFi Direct controls.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu actions for enabling WiFi Direct or starting device discovery.

methods.name: showDetails
methods.description: Displays details for a selected WiFi P2P device.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a WiFi P2P device using specified configuration.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Removes the current WiFi P2P group, disconnecting from the device.

methods.name: onChannelDisconnected
methods.description: Handles WiFi P2P channel disconnection, attempts to reinitialize.

methods.name: cancelDisconnect
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing connect or disconnect operation.
